newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - ITT climbs to 58.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - ITT climbs to 58.

text.p: ITT Corp climbed to 58 in after-hours trading from a close on the New York Stock Exchange of 42-5/8 moments after Hilton Hotels Corp announced it had offered to acquire the company at $55 a share, traders said Monday.
Hilton, whose stock had yet to be seen trading in the after-hours session, said its offer was worth $10.5 billion, including debt.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had a volume of 131,500 shares against 71,100 on Friday, while session two had 81,700 shares compared to 80,300.
